preToolUse.description: Fail-closed secret scan on `git commit` — blocks the commit (exit 2) if the staged diff matches a likely secret.
Fail-closed build+test gate on `git commit` — runs the actual build/test command (Maven or Gradle) and blocks the commit (exit 2) if it fails.

Fail-closed guard on EVERY shell command (not just `git commit`) — blocks (exit 2) destructive git ops (`git reset --hard`, force pushes to main/master, `git clean -fd`), `rm -rf`, DB drops/truncates, `chmod 777`, `curl|bash`, `sudo`, and similar high-risk patterns. Adapted from github/awesome-copilot's tool-guardian hook.

sessionEnd.description: Best-effort audit-log secret scan of the working tree at session end. Non-blocking backstop; the real gate is the preToolUse hook above.
